CHART CODE
 import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

data = {
    'Year': [2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021],
    'OECD Members': [98.2, 98.5, 98.7, 98.9, 99.1, 99.3, 99.5],
    'Mali': [68.0, 70.0, 72.0, 74.0, 76.0, 78.0, 80.0],
    'Turkey': [95.0, 95.5, 96.0, 96.5, 97.0, 97.5, 98.0],
    'Brazil': [88.0, 89.0, 90.0, 91.0, 92.0, 93.0, 94.0],
    'India': [82.0, 83.5, 85.0, 86.5, 88.0, 89.5, 91.0],
    'Nigeria': [58.0, 60.0, 62.0, 64.0, 66.0, 68.0, 70.0]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df = df.melt('Year', var_name='Country', value_name='Access Percentage')

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
sns.set_style('whitegrid')
sns.set_palette('husl', n_colors=6)

ax = sns.lineplot(
    data=df,
    x='Year',
    y='Access Percentage',
    hue='Country',
    style='Country',
    markers=True,
    dashes=False,
    linewidth=2.5
)

plt.fill_between(df.Year.unique(),
                 df[df.Country == 'OECD Members']['Access Percentage'],
                 color=sns.color_palette('husl')[0],
                 alpha=0.2)
plt.fill_between(df.Year.unique(),
                 df[df.Country == 'Mali']['Access Percentage'],
                 color=sns.color_palette('husl')[1],
                 alpha=0.2)
plt.fill_between(df.Year.unique(),
                 df[df.Country == 'Turkey']['Access Percentage'],
                 color=sns.color_palette('husl')[2],
                 alpha=0.2)
plt.fill_between(df.Year.unique(),
                 df[df.Country == 'Brazil']['Access Percentage'],
                 color=sns.color_palette('husl')[3],
                 alpha=0.2)
plt.fill_between(df.Year.unique(),
                 df[df.Country == 'India']['Access Percentage'],
                 color=sns.color_palette('husl')[4],
                 alpha=0.2)
plt.fill_between(df.Year.unique(),
                 df[df.Country == 'Nigeria']['Access Percentage'],
                 color=sns.color_palette('husl')[5],
                 alpha=0.2)

ax.set_title('Trends in Access to Electricity (2015-2021)', fontsize=16, pad=20)
ax.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Percentage of Households with Access', fontsize=12)

plt.xticks(df.Year.unique())
plt.yticks(range(50, 101, 5))
plt.legend(title='Country', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.gca().set_ylim(-4.975, 99.4)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300)

SUMMARY
 This image presents an area chart titled "Trends in Access to Safe Drinking Water (2015-2021)," illustrating the percentage of households with access to safe drinking water across six different regions or groups over a span of seven years. The horizontal axis represents the years from 2015 to 2021, while the vertical axis shows the percentage of households with access, ranging from 50% to 100%.

The chart features six distinct data series, each represented by a different color and corresponding to a specific country or group. The OECD Members, depicted in a soft pink shade, consistently show the highest access rates, starting at 98.2% in 2015 and gradually increasing to 99.5% by 2021. Turkey, shown in green, also exhibits high access rates, beginning at 95.0% in 2015 and reaching 98.0% in 2021.

Brazil is represented in a light brown color and starts at 88.0% in 2015, progressing steadily to 94.0% by 2021. India, illustrated in blue, starts at 82.0% in 2015 and improves to 91.0% in 2021. Mali, shown in orange, begins at 68.0% in 2015 and increases to 80.0% in 2021. Lastly, Nigeria, depicted in purple, has the lowest starting point at 58.0% in 2015, rising to 70.0% by 2021.

Each data series is marked with distinct symbols at each year point, and the area under each line is filled with a lighter shade of the corresponding color, enhancing the visual distinction between the different groups. The chart clearly illustrates an overall upward trend in access to safe drinking water for all the countries and regions displayed.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

table = pd.read_csv("table.csv")
print("Table:\n", table.to_string(index=False))

path = Path("chart.py")
source = path.read_text()
source = source.replace(
    "Trends in Access to Electricity (2015-2021)",
    "Trends in Access to Safe Drinking Water (2015-2021)"
).replace(
    "plt.gca().set_ylim(-4.975, 99.4)",
    "plt.gca().set_ylim(-4.975, 100)"
)
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, "chart.py", "exec"))

ax = plt.gca()
print("Title:", ax.get_title())
print("Y limits:", ax.get_ylim())
print("Data match:", table.equals(pd.DataFrame(data)))
print("Data range:", table.drop(columns="Year").min().min(), table.drop(columns="Year").max().max())
assert table.equals(pd.DataFrame(data))
assert ax.get_title() == "Trends in Access to Safe Drinking Water (2015-2021)"
assert ax.get_ylim() == (-4.975, 100.0)
